name: tg-feed-aggregator
description: Telegram Feed Aggregator PWA — reads public channels via t.me/s scraping, sends keyword digests via a Telegram bot. Deploys to Onreza.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && nitro build && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:pages: tsc -b && vite build && npm install --no-save --package-lock=false @resvg/resvg-js@2.6.2 && node scripts/prerender.mjs
